objective_name: Stored line taxable-value estimation for a confirmed-date domestic goods subset
target_definition: The native numeric Taxable Value cell on one source detail row marked Domestic and G, from a reference whose detail rows share one consistent unambiguous day-first date. The task is offline estimation of this stored line-level field in unspecified source amount units.
assumptions: The exact reference string groups detail rows within this workbook only; issuer-wide identity is unapproved.
Domestic, G and Manual are literal population filters; Manual does not establish a physical unit or currency.
The target is the stored numeric source field. Arithmetic checks provide line-grain evidence but do not establish accounting revenue or a currency conversion.
Item code and quantity are observed inputs for offline field estimation. Their availability before a future business decision has not been independently established.
No source authenticity or business-owner approval is implied by using repository records.
limitations: Exploratory offline field estimation only; no business-approved price, revenue, profit or demand prediction.
Unresolved-date references, exports and services are excluded; the selected population is not representative of all NOP activity.
Item-code identity is scoped to one source field; unseen codes have no learned product effect.
Source amount units and physical quantity units are not independently approved; no aggregation or unit conversion is performed.
The chronological holdout is small and irregularly sampled; prospective business performance is unknown.
observation_grain: one retained source detail row; document grouping is for exclusion and split isolation only
transformations: read raw cells without formula evaluation
require every reference detail date resolved consistently
filter explicit cutoff and literal population
reject invalid required native values with row lineage
project source row features and stored target
period_completeness: not established; no period totals are modeled
